text: Post-publish hero: if an article reaches the CMS before its illustration pass, the post is hero-less. Fix without duplicate posts: re-run publish.py on the _final.md (illustration is digest-idempotent; the WP call dedupes the live post and the row gains metadata.illustration), then wp_draft.py --slug <slug> --refresh-live, which attaches media via ensure_featured_media while keeping status publish.

Evergreen publishes created BEFORE the illustration pass leave the live post hero-less and publish.py re-runs cannot repair it (WP call dedupes on the live post). Repair order that worked (2026-11-26, post 1894): re-run publish.py on the _final.md (illustration idempotent by digest, Supabase row gets metadata.illustration, WP dedupe prints the skip), then wp_draft.py --slug --refresh-live to attach the media, then toggle post status draft->publish to fire the reader front's rebuild, then verify the hero + -1024x576 srcset on the rendered front. og:image on giniloh fronts stays the default share image even for hero-bearing posts — verify the hero , not og:image.
